Title: uTPro URL Viewer
Description: Fetch any URL from the Umbraco backoffice and see exactly what a search engine or browser sees. Supports Umbraco 16, 17 and 18. Choose from Googlebot (smartphone/desktop), Bingbot, Chrome, Firefox or Edge, then inspect the full redirect chain (every hop with status code and raw headers), HTML source, and a complete static analysis: on-page SEO (title, meta description, canonical, H1/H2/H3, noindex, nofollow, lang), Open Graph & Twitter Card, technical SEO (HTTPS, gzip, caching, schema.org, viewport, favicon), content metrics (word count, readability, keyword density, thin-content flag), accessibility subset, spam/hidden-CSS/JavaScript detection and cloaking (bot vs Chrome comparison). Returns a Lighthouse-style composite SEO score (0-100) with per-category sub-scores and individual check pass/fail with remediation advice. Also exposes an authenticated REST API (POST /umbraco/management/api/v1/utpro/url-viewer/fetch) for use in CI pipelines or external tooling. Server-side and SSRF-safe. Built on the framework-agnostic T4VN.Seo.Core engine. (For the site-wide crawler, install the companion uTPro.Feature.SEOAudit.)
